brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: editorial illustration / Japanese sports thumbnail.
Create ONE finished PNG thumbnail, landscape about 16:9, target 1792 x 1008 px (minimum width 1000 px), for バスケまとめ.

Design: the approved black-and-lime hand-inked sports editorial style. Matte near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B expressive dry-brush sweeps, warm ivory lettering, a small orange basketball accent. Rough handmade ink and brush illustration with visible hatching. Few elements, powerful typography, no photorealism, no logos.

Article facts (the ONLY editorial content source is the supplied fixed manuscript): 2026-11-09 daily contribution ranking, 6 games. 岡田 侑大 of 島根 is number 1 with EFF 36, 30 points and 9 assists. Use ONLY the exact text below, no invented claims or extra scores.

Subject: exactly ONE real player, Yuta Okada / 岡田侑大, selected because he is the explicit main subject in the manuscript. His official 2026-27 Shimane roster portrait was visually inspected: youthful Japanese man, lean long-limbed athletic build; black straight thick hair with a rounded fringe just above eyebrows and short sides, hair partly held by a black headband; clean-shaven, softly angular oval face, tapered jaw and rounded chin, straight thick eyebrows, dark almond-shaped eyes, straight fairly narrow nose, compact medium-full lips. Preserve those specific features; do not create a generic fictional athlete. Use a focused expression. Render as a clearly hand-drawn ink illustration, monochrome ivory-and-charcoal skin shading with subtle blue details on a plain basketball uniform, all team/sponsor/league logos and words removed; no jersey lettering or number needed.
Pose: dynamic driving dribble, torso leaning forward diagonally and looking toward the left, right hand controlling a single orange basketball near hip/knee height, left arm naturally bent for balance. Waist-to-above-knees three-quarter view on the RIGHT 44% of canvas. Face, both hands, and the full ball comfortably in frame. Anatomically coherent wrists and five fingers per hand. This is an illustrative play concept, NOT a reconstruction of any actual match moment. No opponent, no victory celebration, no scoreboard.

Layout: strong readable type on LEFT 54%, athlete on right. Keep all text clear of face, hands and ball; at least 60px safe margins. Small brand and date at top left, name as main bold ivory headline, ranking line in bold ivory, EFF 36 as huge lime focal number, secondary stat line underneath. Lime slanted brush trail behind the athlete. Avoid the reference's upright shooting pose; use low forward movement.
Exact text, in this order:
"バスケまとめ"
"2026.11.09"
"岡田 侑大"
"貢献度1位"
"EFF 36"
"島根｜30得点・9アシスト"
Bottom in a fully legible small ivory line, with generous bottom margin:
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"成績をもとにしたイメージ"

All Japanese characters must be correct and crisp. Use sturdy heavy Japanese sans typography with hand-ink texture only around edges. EFF is not points; keep the EFF label attached to 36. Daily scope is fixed by the clearly visible date. Do not add season-best, MVP, official award, nationality category, or decisive-shot claims. No pasted official photos, no photo textures, no league/team/sponsor marks, no watermark except the requested AI label.

SINGLE CORRECTION PASS
Edit the first image, the finished Japanese basketball thumbnail. This is the ONLY permitted correction pass.
Image 1 is the existing design to preserve. Image 2 is an OFFICIAL likeness reference for Yuta Okada ONLY. Do not paste its photo, logos, sponsors, numbers, or words into the artwork.

Fix the top clipping: the entire top of the player's hair must be visible with 45-60 px of near-black background above it, inside the canvas. Reduce and reposition the right-hand player illustration slightly to fit, while preserving the dynamic driving/dribbling pose. Keep face, both natural hands and full orange ball inside the frame with safe margins. Lower body may end at the bottom at mid-thigh, as already composed.
Refine the black hair to match the official likeness more closely: straight dense rounded hair and short fringe around a black headband, not excessively spiked; youthful clean-shaven softly angular oval face with straight thick eyebrows and dark almond eyes. Preserve recognizability as the actual player Yuta Okada. Keep the hand-drawn ink hatching aesthetic, not photography.
Preserve the approved near-black #151A18, lime #CCF43B and ivory scheme, plain blue uniform without marks, orange ball, brush strokes, layout and all Japanese text EXACTLY as currently written. Maintain readability and separation from player. Do not add anything.
